subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Recognises and uses synonyms (happy / glad) and antonyms (good / bad)

show.line: Happy and glad mean the same. They are synonyms. Good and bad are opposites. They are antonyms!

rounds.prompt: Which word means the same as big?
rounds.praise: Yes! Big and large are synonyms.

rounds.prompt: Which word is the opposite of hot?
rounds.praise: Yes! Hot and cold are antonyms.

rounds.prompt: Say a word that means the same as happy.
Which word is the opposite of fast?
Same as happy, or opposite of happy? Sort the words.
The giant was enormous. Which word means the same as enormous?
Which pair of words are antonyms?
rounds.praise: Yes! Up and down are opposites.

hints: Synonyms are the same. Antonyms are opposites.
Think of a word that could swap in and keep the meaning.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find the opposite of tall.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: The opposite of tall is high!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Tall and high mean the same. The opposite of tall is short.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's think together. A tall tree, a short tree. Short is the opposite!

parent_line: Can find words that mean the same and words that are opposites.
